about: Template decisions every app starts from. Agents do not reopen these. To change one, write a change request.

decisions.why: What the store pack uses and what the agent writes best.

decisions.choice: shadcn/ui components copied into src/components/ui, Radix primitives, Tailwind CSS 4 with CSS variable tokens
decisions.why: Accessibility is handled, the code is owned by the app, and the look settings can drive every component.
Keeps visitor and owner input inside the schema.

decisions.choice: Playwright end-to-end scripts in e2e/, plus one check per edge in specs/edges.json
decisions.why: Verification is automatic; a run passes only when these pass.
A marketing site takes no money.
TypeScript 7 does not work with the Next.js tooling yet; an unpinned install picked it and cost a rebuild.

decisions.choice: No database, no ORM, no server API routes, no environment variables. The page is static, rendered from src/content/site.ts
decisions.why: A showcase stores nothing. Fewer parts means a faster build and a faster deploy.

decisions.choice: One Vercel project per site, deployed directly from the site folder with the Vercel CLI. No GitHub repository is required in this version
decisions.why: Fewer moving parts. The owner can download the source as a zip.

decisions.choice: None. Nothing is collected or sent
decisions.why: Email and sign-ups are integrations, handled in a later version.

decisions.choice: package.json has the scripts "dev", "build", "start" and "test:e2e". It has no "db:migrate", "db:seed" or "hash-password"
decisions.why: The deploy script for this pack runs the build only: no migration, seed or owner password.
